propositions: A standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder is needed that computes detection_proxy and blocking_fp_proxy metrics from sidecar review history alone, without the outcome-corpus git-walk cost of R7, so that advisory criteria can be monitored for promotion/demotion automatically at zero marginal LLM cost.

The recorder (criterion_effectiveness.py --record --backfill) appends one lean firing row per (review-round, finding) to an append-only, prune-immune ledger (criterion_firings.jsonl), auto-including every criterion id present, with dedup key (ticket_id, review_ts_ns, round_uuid, norm_id) to ensure idempotent re-runs.

The --report mode computes per-criterion detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction later dropped without remediation) over a trailing window of tickets, with sample_counts denominators so rates are null when denominator is zero.

The metrics artifact (criterion_effectiveness.json) is committed and CI-visible, proving the recorder works over existing corpus data now with 40+ auto-included criteria, real non-null proxy values, and zero LLM calls.
